name: ai-usage-coach
description: Personal AI usage coach for Claude Desktop power users who aren't developers. Analyzes your local Claude Code / Cowork session logs (plus an optional claude.ai chat export), has Claude write personalized coaching, and renders a local HTML report (/coach). Also generates an aggregate-only, shareable 'AI agent field notes' research report (/field-notes). 100% local: no data leaves your machine.
